title: koredocs_update_replaces_old_content
prompts: Using KoreDocs MCP: create a koredoc in folder /Tests/UpdateTests, filename replace-test.koredoc, content: ORIGINAL_UNIQUE_STRING_ABC123
Using koredocs_file_update with that file's id, replace the entire content with: REPLACEMENT_UNIQUE_STRING_XYZ789. Confirm success.
Now read that file back using the id and confirm: does the content now contain REPLACEMENT_UNIQUE_STRING_XYZ789? Does it still contain ORIGINAL_UNIQUE_STRING_ABC123?
